grades.lower_bound_mechanism: defect/self-duality stabilization with cofactor entry bound (finiteness unproved)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: periodic valid set: residue classes mod L, T per window, from n=1
grades.notes: Steps 1–3 rigorously prove (C): sequence is the increasing enumeration of V from a_1, unconditionally. Step 4 fully assembles (P): L=product of essential primes, T=window count, a_{n+T}=a_n+L from n=1—but conditional on finiteness of essential primes, which is admitted open. (F) only sketched via cofactor/defect lemma plus computation. No false lemma relied on.
